name: python-error-handling
description: Python validation, exceptions, domain conversion, partial failures.

Validate early, before expensive operations; report all errors at once when possible. Validate every input at API boundaries before processing. Check required fields/ranges; raise informative `ValueError`s. Parse external strings into typed domain objects at boundaries; list valid options for unknown values. Use Pydantic `BaseModel`, `Field`, and validators for structured inputs. Use contextual exceptions; explain failure, why, and fix. Use `ValueError` for invalid input, `TypeError` for wrong type, `KeyError` for missing item, `RuntimeError` for operational failure, `TimeoutError` for timeo
